test_mcts_agent: test the MCTS agent by running an EnvironmentLoop with a fake discrete environment for 2 episodes
create_mcts_agent: create an MCTS agent with a Sonnet MLP network, Simulator model, and Adam optimizer
build_discrete_environment: build a fake DiscreteEnvironment with 5 actions, 10 observations, and episode length 10
